test_title: PYST 13: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A % B means ‘A is the daughter of B’

A = B means ‘A is the sister of B’

A $ B means ‘A is the father of B’

X % Y = Z % W $ V, then how is Z related to V?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/599c31a3b6c5ca06ce1787b908a152975e0540fada6e60ee63a4282f38f5a661.png] 

A % B means ‘A is the daughter of B’

A = B means ‘A is the sister of B’

A $ B means ‘A is the father of B’

 
 

 Symbol
 %
 =
 $
 
 

 Meaning
 Daughter 
 Sister
 Father
 
 

The given expression is :-

'X % Y = Z % W $ V' → X is daughter of Y, Y is sister of Z, Z is daughter of W, W is father of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/028c67b58d372dedcc4912662387d9fad74becd044cb4ac61c9a7c320160b480.png] 

∴ Here, 'Z' is sister to 'V'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Sister".**
